verdict.rationale: Postman documents a first-party Postman API for programmatically managing Postman assets and integrating with toolchains, plus an Analytics API, and pairs it with an official CLI covering collection runs, mocks, linting, governance checks, SDK generation and webhooks. Nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates that the API matches what the UI can do. UI-centric features such as live sessions, comments, Agent Mode, the visual workflow builder and Spec Hub design show no documented API equivalents. missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity claim or coverage map, API coverage evidence for collaboration, AI and design features, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
